angle: Two different answers to the same question — React keeps a scheduler and fiber tree in-tree; Vue splits reactivity, runtime, and compiler into separate packages.
Runtime-vs-compiler tradeoffs: Vue ships a reactive runtime, Svelte compiles components to direct DOM operations.
Vite's on-demand ESM dev server vs webpack's bundle-first graph — two generations of frontend build architecture.
Node's C++ core plus npm ecosystem vs Deno's Rust/V8 single binary with permissions and web-standard APIs.
Bun's Zig/JavaScriptCore all-in-one toolchain vs Node's V8/libuv runtime plus separate package tooling.
Two post-Node runtimes — Deno leans on V8 and Rust crates, Bun on JavaScriptCore and Zig.
Flask's WSGI microframework plus extension ecosystem vs FastAPI's ASGI + type-annotation-driven API surface.
curl's C protocol engine vs HTTPie's Python human-first CLI — same problem, opposite philosophies.
The default HTTP clients of JS and Python — promise-chain interceptors vs session-based synchronous calls.
